reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators derive from two primary dualities: (1) slate scope and (2) injury status. The slate scope correction is a scalar transformation applied to salary-normalized projections, where \( S_{\text{non-Sun}} \) is not equivalent to \( S_{\text{Sun}} \). This introduces a scaling factor \( f_{\text{norm}} \) that adjusts expected points per dollar. Injury tagging introduces a probabilistic reduction in target share, modeled as \( T_{\text{proj}} \cdot g(I_{\text{status}}) \), where \( g \) is a decreasing function of injury severity. Failure modes include misalignment of injury reports and projection models, or incorrect application of \( f_{\text{norm}} \) when salary pools are consistent. Dualities are maintained through Bayesian conditioning on injury data and historical target trends.
